nodes.label: ADR 0036: Governance File Exemption and Serialized Shared Write Set
Serialized Shared Write Set and Governance Exemption
nodes.rationale: All 15 cross-phase duplicate write paths in 12 archived indices sat between dependency-serialized phase pairs and governance-file duplicates were zero, so exempting the closed 7-file governance set and ancestry-related phases removes the incentive to merge independent phases merely to bypass the duplicate check.
